english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things using, produced by, or related to electronic and digital technology.
Use this for digital technology when the context focuses on electronic devices, services, or media rather than the numeric encoding itself.
Use this for an electronic version of an instrument such as an electronic keyboard.

examples.english: I use electronic payment, so I don't need to bring a wallet.
examples.traditional: 我用電子支付，唔使帶銀包。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 din6 zi2 zi1 fu6 m4 sai2 daai3 ngan4 baau1

examples.english: I use digital books to read novels, so I don't have to carry so many books.
examples.traditional: 我用電子書睇小說，唔使帶咁多本書。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 din6 zi2 syu1 tai2 siu2 syut3 m4 sai2 daai3 gam3 do1 bun2 syu1

examples.english: I practise on an electric keyboard at night without disturbing the neighbours.
examples.traditional: 我用電子琴練琴，夜晚唔會嘈到鄰居。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 din6 zi2 kam4 lin6 kam4 je6 maan5 m4 wui5 cou4 dou3 leon4 gei1
